title: Neruda Concerto - Rapid Tonguing & Rhythm (Bars 6–10)

goals.goal: Keep 16th-note double tonguing crisp, light, and forward-placed.
goals.teacherNote: Focus on tip of tongue touch without tension in embouchure.

goals.goal: Lock into the metronome subdivision through syncopated entrances.
goals.teacherNote: Subdivide eighths in your head before entering on beat 2.

teacherGeneralNotes: Practice 15 minutes daily. First shadow finger with audio demo, then record your official take!
